description: Validate a plate number against the country's format (look-alike letters are normalized) and say which region its code belongs to. Pass type to check against a specific plate type's format. Never identifies the owner or the vehicle's location. Use it to check a specific plate number.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. RU.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

number.description: Plate number without the region, e.g. A123BC. Look-alike Latin letters are normalized.

region.description: Region code if the country shows one, e.g. 77.

type.description: Plate type key from get_license_plate_country, e.g. on Russian plates diplomatic (red), police (blue), military (black), taxi_bus (yellow). Default: the country's standard plate.

name: check_license_plate
title: Check A License Plate
